form.label: History
form.description: Every restore and delete, from archive_restore.log in index=_internal.

search.query: index=_internal source=*archive_restore.log* action=* | stats count, sum(bytes) AS bytes, latest(_time) AS last BY user action index status | eval GB=round(bytes/1024/1024/1024, 2), last=strftime(last, "%F %T") | fields - bytes
index=_internal source=*archive_restore.log* status IN ("failed", "rejected") | table _time user action index bucket status reason | sort - _time
